dictionary.attribution: JMdict / EDRDG; selected lexical facts only, no upstream examples, Chinese translations, audio or full dictionary bundled.

semanticBoundaries: 嫁 has separate wife, bride and daughter-in-law targets with two contexts each. They share the same glyph/reading review only, not meaning mastery, and remain one root.
実は orthographicじつは and phoneticじつわ are accepted only from the explicit particle-pronunciation note; no global は→わ normalization.
永久 literaryとわ／とこしえ and幼いいとけない use separately checked current entries with matching meanings, not all forms from those entries.
癖へき is limited to habit, not curls/creases; 翼よく to the physical wing, not constellation/counter; 小屋しょうおく to hut/shed, not all theatre/house uses.
金庫 has a physical-safe meaning. Alternativeかねぐら belongs to an entry where金庫 is search-only, so it is not imported. 詩うた remains a separately scoped modern-poetry case; no blanket alias of all歌 senses.
梅むめ, 酔うえう, 憲法けんぼう, 笛ちゃく and左右そう are obsolete reading forms and are not ordinary answers.
No inferred pitch accents. All words remain trial; source and structure checks are not independent Japanese language review.
